test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 20 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Given below is a statement followed by two possible reasons numbered I and II. Read the statement carefully and decide which of the two explain(s) the event/observation/information given in the statement.

Statement - Even though the students of school X have ranked among the top three in board exams for the past three years, the school has never received the best school award.

Reasons:

I. School X has high tuition fees.

II. The best school award takes into consideration other activities along with academics.

options.text: Only II is a possible reason.
Neither I nor II is a possible reason.
Only I is a possible reason.
Both I and II are possible reasons.

solution:
**Given statement:** Even though the students of school X have ranked among the top three in board exams for the past three years, the school has never received the best school award.

**Given reasons:**

I. School X has high tuition fees. → False/ Not possible

High school fees may effect accessibility but not necessarily impact award decisions.

II. The best school award takes into consideration other activities along with academics. → True/ Possible

If the award considers extra curricular activities along with academics, then a school excelling only in academics may not necessarily win.

Thus, Only II is a possible reason.

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.
